PFE.headline: Enanta Pharmaceuticals Files Patent Infringement Lawsuit Against Pfizer Over Alleged Infringement Of European Patent Regarding Pfizer's Manufacture, Use, And Sale Of Paxlovid
Pfizer Enters R&D Collaboration with Edison Scientific
PFE.summary: Pfizer has entered into an agreement with Edison Scientific to utilize its "Kosmos" platform to accelerate drug discovery and R&D decision-making.

PFE.headline: Pfizer Reports Reduction in Payments to Swiss Healthcare Professionals
PFE.summary: Pfizer's payments to healthcare professionals and organizations in Switzerland decreased by 10 million Swiss francs in 2025, totaling 11.3 million francs.

PFE.headline: Pfizer Announces Corporate Restructuring and Clinical Trial Adjustments
PFE.summary: Pfizer has initiated a corporate restructuring and workforce reduction program while simultaneously adjusting its clinical trial pipeline.

PFE.headline: Pfizer Divests Stake in ViiV Healthcare
PFE.summary: Pfizer has exited its equity holding in the HIV-focused joint venture ViiV Healthcare, receiving $1.875 billion as part of a restructuring transaction.

PFE.headline: Pfizer Cancer Therapy Shows Extended Progression-Free Survival in Multiple Myeloma Patients
PFE.summary: Pfizer reports positive Phase 3 ELREXFIO data showing reduced disease progression risk in relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma patients.

PFE.headline: Pfizer Announces Positive Topline Results from Phase 3 MagnetisMM-32 Study of ELREXFIO
PFE.summary: Pfizer reported that its Phase 3 MagnetisMM-32 trial met its primary endpoint of progression-free survival in patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma.

PFE.headline: Pfizer Reports Consistent Safety Profile for Elrexfio in Magnetismm-32 Study
PFE.summary: Pfizer announced that the safety profile of its therapy Elrexfio (elranatamab) in the Magnetismm-32 clinical study remains consistent with its previously established profile.

PFE.headline: Pfizer Announces That Topline Results In The Phase 3 MagnetisMM-32 Trial Of ELREXFIO Demonstrated Clinically Meaningful And Statistically Significant Benefit For Patients Whose Disease Progressed After Anti-CD38 Therapy And Lenalidomide, With Median PFS Not Yet Reached
Pfizer Receives FDA Approval for TALZENNA Combination Therapy
PFE.summary: The U.S. FDA has approved the use of Pfizer's TALZENNA (talazoparib) in combination with XTANDI for the treatment of specific prostate cancer patients.

PFE.headline: FDA Approves Talazoparib With Enzalutamide For Metastatic Androgen Pathway Modulation-Naive Or -Sensitive Prostate Cancer With HRR Gene Mutations
Jefferies Maintains Buy Rating on Pfizer
PFE.summary: Jefferies reaffirmed its 'Buy' rating and $36 price target for Pfizer, citing recent Phase II clinical data.

PFE.headline: Reported Saturday, Pfizer Presents Phase 2 25vPnC Infant Data At IDWeek 2026: Robust Responses To All 25 Serotypes, Including Five New, Safety Comparable To PREVNAR 20, No Related Serious Adverse Events
